children: Movers who show up and take care of your stuff
Local, friendly and fully insured — with flat, upfront quotes and crews that treat your things like their own. Get a free estimate online and we’ll give you a real price before moving day.

children: You get one clear, written price before we lift a box — no hourly meter creeping up, no surprise fees added on at the curb when the truck’s already full.
Every crew is background-checked, uniformed and fully insured. Furniture gets blanket-wrapped, floors get protected, and doorframes go home without a scratch.
Boxes, tape, wrap and dish barrels — we can bring it all, or pack the whole place for you. Nothing loaded loose, nothing you have to figure out yourself.
We give you a real arrival window and text when we’re on the way. Moving day runs on your schedule, not ours — and we don’t leave until it’s done right.

children: We treat your things like they’re ours

Anyone can carry a box. What sets Sure Hands apart is what happens to the things you actually care about — the dresser from your grandmother, the TV you just paid for, the corner of the wall on the way out the door.
We wrap furniture in blankets, pad the sharp edges, lay runners on your floors and shrink-wrap the drawers so nothing shifts. Careful isn’t slower with us — it’s just how the job gets done.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Sure Hands Moving is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: Two uniformed movers carrying a wrapped sofa down a front walk to a loaded truck

children: We started Sure Hands because moving shouldn’t be the horror story everyone warns you about — the crew that shows up late, the price that doubles at the end, the coffee table that comes off the truck with a fresh gouge.

We’re a local, family-run moving company serving homes and apartments across the area. Flat quotes, careful insured crews, and movers who genuinely take care of your stuff. Same friendly faces, honest prices, and a job done right the first time.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: How a move with us works
We look at what you’re moving, talk through the details, and hand you one clear written quote. Nothing starts, and nothing changes, until you say yes to the number.
Furniture gets blankets, floors get runners, walls get corner guards. We move like it’s our own home, because a clean move is the whole point of hiring pros.
Done right, or we make it right
We’re licensed and insured, and we stand behind every move. If something isn’t right, you call us and we fix it — we’re your neighbors, not a call center.
